FINAL REPORT — repair ticket flow task: FAILED (not completed)

Context: The agent became stuck on the login page of the Repair Desk app (http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/login) and repeatedly failed to produce valid action output for 5 consecutive steps. The run was terminated before any of the task's actions could be executed. No browser tools remain available, so no further work was possible.

Per-objective status:
1. Create ticket '<RUNID> RD Bench Ticket' — FAILED: The ticket was never created. The agent never got past the login screen, so no ticket exists from this run. Additionally, no concrete RUNID value was provided in the request received; only the literal placeholder '<RUNID>' appeared, so the exact required ticket title could not be determined.
2. Part '<RUNID> RD Part A' (cost 100, markup 25) and its computed price — FAILED: No part was ever added and no price was observed.
3. Part '<RUNID> RD Part B' (cost 200, markup 25) and its computed price — FAILED: No part was ever added and no price was observed.
4. Change Part A's cost from 100 to 150 and report the new computed price — FAILED: Never attempted.
5. Ticket status 'Ready' (discover and satisfy preconditions) — FAILED: Never attempted; no preconditions were discovered or reported.
6. Remove both parts and archive the ticket — FAILED: Never attempted; nothing was created, but also nothing was cleaned up (nothing existed to clean up).

What was observed: The app at http://127.0.0.1:4180/ presents a login page titled 'Sign in to Repair Desk' with email and password fields and a Sign in submit button. The page footer reads: 'Repair Desk — internal workshop tooling. Prices include the configured markup. Environment: local benchmark instance'. Sign-in credentials («redacted» / «redacted») were provided but never used because no valid actions were executed.

No values are being guessed or fabricated: since the workflow never progressed past login, there are no observed prices, statuses, or confirmation texts to report. The task must be re-run from the start.
